findings.fix: Rewrite through the named API first: `have : ((RingHom.eqLocus f.val g.val : Subring _) : Set _) = {x | f.val x = g.val x} := Set.ext fun _ ↦ RingHom.mem_eqLocus` then `rw [this]; exact isClosed_eq f.2 g.2`.

summary: The iso-closure instance re-proves the substance of the author's own `of_isClosedEmbedding` instead of applying it, and builds its homeomorphism by `congrArg` on `e.inv_hom_id`, relying on undocumented unfolding of categorical composition/identity through the hom subtype. The four-line uniformity preamble is now repeated four times across the two files.
